status.main_product: AI-driven financial infrastructure and treasury automation software
status.scope_reason: The company builds and operates digital treasury, trade, and supply chain finance infrastructure, utilizing task-specific AI agents to execute complex trade finance processes and automate connectivity with financial institutions.
status.evidence: According to a Global Trade Review report, Xalts builds digital treasury, trade, and supply chain finance infrastructure to digitise operational processes between businesses and financial institutions.

claims.claim: MUFG Bank completed a fully digital transaction in 2025 on behalf of Tata International, processing a $15 million letter of credit using the company's network.

In February 2024, Xalts Technologies Pte. Ltd. completed the acquisition of Contour Network, a blockchain-based trade finance network built on R3's Corda platform that maintains pre-existing documentation and workflow integrations with external partners including CargoX, Bolero, and essDOCS.

In June 2024, Xalts announced upgrades to the Contour network enabling users to prepare and compare letter of credit applications against SWIFT messaging standards, with additional planned API integrations to ease system connections.
The company reports its SPARC application is a unified bank connectivity API designed to integrate multiple enterprise banking networks under universal data exchange schemas.
claims.note: The SPARC application and its description as a unified bank connectivity API cannot be confirmed from company or news sources.

claims.claim: Xalts completed a digital transaction with MUFG and Tata International over its network in February 2025 using its updated blockchain infrastructure and AI capabilities.
claims.note: The specific inclusion of "AI capabilities" in the transaction infrastructure could not be verified in published reports.

claims.claim: In February 2025, MUFG Bank went live on the Xalts bank connectivity network and executed a fully digitalized $15 million Letter of Credit transaction from its GIFT City branch for a subsidiary of Tata International Limited.

Xalts acquired the digital trade finance network Contour in February 2024, integrating a network framework that historically counted over 22 global banks and 100 businesses, including HSBC, BNP Paribas, Standard Chartered, and Rio Tinto.
The company announced a $6 million seed funding round in October 2022 co-led by Accel and Citi Ventures, with additional participation from Polygon co-founder Sandeep Nailwal.

The company utilized cash and stock to acquire the digital trade network Contour from a bank consortium in February 2024, receiving continuing transaction support from early backers Accel and Citi Ventures.
In February 2024, Xalts Technologies Pte. Ltd. acquired the Contour Network, a digital trade platform used by over 22 banks and more than 100 global businesses including Tata Group and Rio Tinto.
In February 2025, MUFG Bank went live on the Xalts bank connectivity network for corporate treasuries operating in GIFT City, processing a US$15 million letter of credit for Tata International.
